retrievalProfile.description: A dual-toned surrealist composition featuring a human profile integrated into architectural blocks with a sharp vertical division between warm and cool palettes.

recipe.visualDefinition: A central square frame divided vertically: the left side features warm yellow and orange hues with wavy, organic textures and blocky geometric extrusions; the right side is dark, muted brown with a rigid grid pattern. A stylized human profile emerges from the center, bridging both halves.
coreVisualRelationships: Vertical bisection of warm and cool color fields
Integration of organic human features with rigid geometric blocks
Contrast between wavy background patterns and structured grid lines
Top-right and bottom-left typographic placement framing the central art
coreInvariants: Sharp vertical division line through the center of the subject
Airbrushed soft-focus gradients on all surfaces
Geometric 'L' shaped blocks protruding from the left side

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Large central square containing the primary illustration, occupying 80% of the canvas.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The human profile at the center-right of the inner square.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes move from the bright yellow top-left, down the geometric blocks, across to the dark grid, and finally to the text at the top-right and bottom-left.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Solid black border surrounding the central square artwork.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep charcoal and muted brown (right side and border)
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Pale lavender and pink (bottom text and highlights)
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the two halves; low saturation in the dark areas vs high saturation in the warm areas.

letterConstructionRules: High contrast between thick and thin strokes
Sharp, pointed serifs on the bottom text
Mixed case for the top branding with specific character scaling
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'FIXX' characters are enlarged and tightly tracked
The 'PHANTOMS' text uses wide tracking and sharp triangular serifs
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Contrast between a compact, elegant top-right serif and a wide, authoritative bottom-left serif.

preserve: Specific color-coding for top vs bottom text

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the high-contrast stroke and sharp serifs of the display text.
Matches the wide, small-serif feel of the bottom text.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a square illustration on a black background. The square is split vertically: the left side has yellow/orange airbrushed waves and 3D blocks; the right side has a dark brown grid. A human profile is integrated into the center.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add high-contrast serif text in the top-right corner in pale yellow, and wide-tracked all-caps serif text in the bottom-left corner in lavender.

verificationChecks: Is the central image a perfect square?
Is there a clear vertical split in color and texture?
Is the background outside the square solid black?

adjustableVariables: Saturation of the yellow vs brown halves
mustRedesign: Avoid using any existing band logos
Ensure the human profile is stylized and not a specific person
postGenerationChecks: Check for vertical alignment of the split
Ensure text does not overlap the central square
Confirm the color palette matches the warm/cool divide
